text:
tess-finance: Quick deal-desk ask for Gridly (pilot customer). They disputed Apr billing and asked for a refund. Proposal: one-time credit $14,250 + waive the $250 late fee and offer 1 invoice at pilot rate (10% off) if they commit to convert to a 6-month committed plan. Need CFO + legal ok.

leo-sales: Sales supports conversion incentive. Gridly is close to signing a 6-mo commit; this concession seals the deal. They asked us to move quickly.

sam-ops: Reconciled numbers: billed tokens 460k vs expected 300k in pilot. Overage = $16,200. We confirmed part of spike was due to a misconfigured CI job during onboarding. Sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/gridly-apr-recon (view).

billing-bot: Invoice: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-04-29
Amount: $25,800
Lines: Base PILOT-300K: $9,600; Overage: $16,200; Late Fee: $250
```

tess-finance: Rationale: (1) sales promised a small onboarding allowance which wasn't applied, (2) operational CI spike partly our fault, (3) conversion upside to committed spend. Proposed credit covers most of the overage but keeps some usage charge to avoid full write-off.

clare-cfo: I can approve credits up to $15k with GC sign-off. This one is within limit but need legal amendment that ties credit to committing to a 6-month plan and includes non-precedent language. Also cc AR for JE posting.

nick-legal: Drafting short addendum: "This one-time reconciliation credit and fee waiver is conditioned on Customer execution of a 6-month service commitment at the agreed rate and is not precedent for other accounts." Will prepare DocuSign. Any additional terms?

leo-sales: No extra terms. Customer will sign immediately once amendment is sent. They prefer minimal wording.

tess-finance: Suggested JE for AR: 
```
DR Customer Credits (4102) $14,250
CR Revenue (4001) $14,250
Memo: Gridly Apr recon credit, attach amendment DSGN-xxxx
```

billing-bot: DocuSign envelope created DSGN-990011. Status: sent. Invoice INV-2026-04-29 flagged PENDING-CREDIT.

clare-cfo: Approved $14,250 credit + waive late fee + 1 invoice 10% pilot discount contingent on signed amendment and AR posting. Document concession in DEAL_DESK.

nick-legal: Amendment uploaded: https://legal.internal/redwood/amendments/gridly-pilot-credit-v1.pdf. Waiting on customer signature.

tess-finance: Thanks all 12 I'll follow up when DocuSign completes and AR posts credit memo. Leo please own customer comms.

leo-sales: Will send comms and confirm signature. :thumbsup:
